name: Aadhaar
description: India's 12-digit biometric digital identity number, issued by UIDAI.

name: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System
description: NPCI system that lets customers make bank transactions at micro-ATMs using Aadhaar authentication.

name: Association of Investment Bankers of India
description: Industry association of SEBI-registered merchant bankers and investment banks in India.

name: Association of Mutual Funds in India
description: Industry association of SEBI-registered mutual fund asset management companies in India.

name: Association of NSE Members of India
description: Pan-India association of stock-broking trading members of the National Stock Exchange; formerly the Association of National Exchanges Members of India.

name: Bharat Connect (formerly Bharat BillPay)
description: Bill payment system (Bharat Bill Payment System, BBPS) operated by NPCI Bharat BillPay Limited (NBBL), an NPCI subsidiary; rebranded from Bharat BillPay to Bharat Connect.

name: BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money)
description: UPI-based payments app and brand of NPCI.

name: BSE Limited
description: Stock exchange in Mumbai, established in 1875 as the Bombay Stock Exchange; operator of the S&P BSE Sensex market.

name: CARE Ratings (CareEdge Ratings)
description: Credit rating agency operating under the CareEdge brand.

name: Central Board of Direct Taxes
description: Statutory board under the Department of Revenue that frames direct tax policy and administers the Income Tax Department.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005. CBDT uses the Income Tax Department logo (shared file).

name: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
description: Statutory board under the Department of Revenue that administers GST (central), customs and central excise.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: Central Depository Services (India) Limited
description: Securities depository in Mumbai, promoted by BSE, holding securities in dematerialised form.

name: Computer Age Management Services
description: Registrar and transfer agent to Indian mutual funds, based in Chennai.

name: Confederation of Indian Industry
description: Non-government, industry-led business association in India.

name: CRIF High Mark Credit Information Services
description: Credit bureau licensed by the RBI, part of the CRIF group.

name: Crisil
description: Rating, research and risk and policy advisory company, a company of S&P Global.

name: Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation
description: Deposit insurer for banks in India; a wholly owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India.

name: DigiLocker
description: Government of India digital document wallet under the Digital India programme for issuing and verifying official documents.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: Digital India
description: Government of India flagship programme, launched in 2015, to build digital infrastructure and deliver government services electronically.

name: Equifax Credit Information Services
description: Indian credit bureau of the Equifax group, licensed by the RBI.

name: Experian Credit Information Company of India
description: Indian credit bureau of the Experian group, licensed by the RBI.

name: Export-Import Bank of India
description: India's export-import bank, a statutory institution set up under the Export-Import Bank of India Act to finance and promote India's international trade.

name: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry
description: Apex business association of India, founded in 1927.

name: Finance Industry Development Council
description: Apex industry association of NBFCs, recognised by the Reserve Bank of India as the Self-Regulatory Organisation for NBFCs.

name: Foreign Exchange Dealers' Association of India
description: Self-regulatory association of banks dealing in foreign exchange in India; sets rules for interbank forex business.

name: General Insurance Council
description: Industry association of India's general (non-life) insurance companies.

name: Immediate Payment Service
description: NPCI's 24x7 instant interbank electronic funds transfer service.

name: Income Tax Department
description: Government agency that administers direct taxes in India, functioning under the Central Board of Direct Taxes.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited
description: Wholly owned Government of India company set up in 2006 to provide long-term finance to infrastructure projects.

name: Indian Energy Exchange
description: India's largest power exchange, providing a trading platform for electricity, renewable energy and certificates; regulated by CERC.

name: Indian Gas Exchange
description: India's gas exchange for delivery-based trading of natural gas, promoted by Indian Energy Exchange (an associate of IEX, which holds 47.28%).

name: Indian Institute of Banking and Finance
description: Professional body that educates and certifies bankers in India.

name: Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association
description: Not-for-profit apex industry body for India's venture capital, private equity and alternate capital industry.

name: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
description: Regulator of insolvency professionals, agencies, information utilities and processes under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
description: Regulator of India's insurance sector, constituted under the IRDA Act, 1999.

name: International Financial Services Centres Authority
description: Unified regulator for financial services in India's International Financial Services Centres (GIFT IFSC), set up under the IFSCA Act, 2019.

name: Invest India
description: National Investment Promotion and Facilitation Agency of India, set up as a not-for-profit venture under DPIIT.

name: KFin Technologies
description: Registrar and transfer agent and investor-services platform for mutual funds and corporate issuers, based in Hyderabad.

name: MF Central
description: Unified investor-services platform for mutual fund transactions, built jointly by the registrars CAMS and KFintech.

name: Microfinance Industry Network
description: Industry association and RBI-recognised Self-Regulatory Organisation of NBFC-MFIs and other microfinance lenders.

name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs
description: Union ministry that administers the Companies Act, 2013, the LLP Act and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, and runs the MCA21 company registry.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: MUFG Intime India Private Limited
description: Registrar and share transfer agent, formerly Link Intime India; part of MUFG Pension & Market Services. Uses the MUFG group logo.

name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India
description: India's largest commodity derivatives exchange, trading bullion, base metals, energy and agricultural contracts.

name: nasscom
description: Trade association of India's technology industry (IT services, products and start-ups).

name: National Automated Clearing House
description: NPCI's bulk clearing system for high-volume recurring credits and debits such as salaries, subsidies and EMIs.

name: National Commodity Clearing Limited
description: Clearing corporation of the NCDEX group.

name: National Institute of Securities Markets
description: Educational institute established by SEBI for capacity building, certification and research in the securities markets.

name: National Payments Corporation of India
description: Umbrella organisation for retail payment and settlement systems in India, set up by the RBI and the Indian Banks' Association; operates UPI, RuPay, IMPS, NACH, AePS and NETC.

name: National Portal of India (india.gov.in)
description: Official single-window web portal of the Government of India, run by the National Informatics Centre.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: National Securities Depository Limited
description: India's first securities depository, set up in 1996; holds securities of investors in dematerialised form.

name: National Stock Exchange of India
description: India's largest stock exchange by trading volume, operating equity, derivatives, currency, commodity and debt segments; based in Mumbai.

name: NCDEX Limited
description: Commodity derivatives exchange focused on agricultural commodities, formerly National Commodity & Derivatives Exchange Limited; based in Mumbai.

name: NETC FASTag
description: National Electronic Toll Collection programme of NPCI; FASTag is its RFID tag for electronic toll payment.

name: NITI Aayog
description: Policy think tank of the Government of India (National Institution for Transforming India), chaired by the Prime Minister; replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: Open Network for Digital Commerce
description: Open, interoperable network for digital commerce, a not-for-profit company backed by the Government of India (DPIIT).

name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority
description: Pension regulator of India under the PFRDA Act; oversees the National Pension System and Atal Pension Yojana.

name: Reserve Bank of India
description: India's central bank and monetary authority, constituted under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

name: RuPay
description: India's domestic card payment network, operated by NPCI.

name: Sahamati
description: Industry alliance of India's Account Aggregator ecosystem.

name: Securities and Exchange Board of India
description: Regulator of India's securities and commodity derivatives markets, set up under the SEBI Act, 1992.

name: Small Industries Development Bank of India
description: Principal financial institution for promoting, financing and developing India's micro, small and medium enterprise (MSME) sector.

name: State Emblem of India
description: National emblem of India, adapted from the Lion Capital of Ashoka at Sarnath with the motto Satyameva Jayate; adopted on 26 January 1950.
usageNote: Contains the State Emblem of India; use is restricted by the State Emblem of India (Prohibition of Improper Use) Act, 2005.

name: The Clearing Corporation of India Limited
description: Central counterparty for government securities, money market, forex and rupee derivatives trades, set up in 2001 at the initiative of the Reserve Bank of India.

name: The Institute of Cost Accountants of India
description: Statutory body regulating the profession of cost and management accountancy in India.

name: Unified Payments Interface
description: NPCI's real-time mobile payment system for instant transfers between bank accounts.

name: Unique Identification Authority of India
description: Statutory authority under MeitY, established under the Aadhaar Act, 2016, that issues and manages Aadhaar numbers.

name: UPI 123PAY
description: NPCI's UPI payment service for feature phones.

name: UPI Lite
description: NPCI's on-device wallet for small-value UPI payments.
